limits: The WES bridge uses bounded synthetic UPBA batches reconstructed from deterministic seeds.
WES ranks dominance-cover candidate claims; UPBA verification and dominance-cover checking provide labels.
The bridge is search-efficiency evidence only. It is not a UPBA v2 bounded-grid production verifier.
negative_knowledge: Weak pruned sets remain useful negative controls because the checker rejects uncovered better verified candidates.
A passing WES search report does not remove the full-list completeness obligation for bounded-grid claims.

wes_report.boundary: This compares WES ordering policies only. Checker verdicts and witness promotion remain authoritative and replay-gated.
